name: Soyuz MS-20
about: Soyuz MS-20 (2021-119A), a crewed vehicle (Soyuz MS), launched 2021 Dec  8. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2021 Dec  8), held fixed
docked to S36086; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
